HAGADOL ERP — CRM DESIGN REBUILD
25 October 2026

TO SEE THE NEW DESIGN NOW
1. Extract this ZIP.
2. Open review/Hagadol_CRM_Design_Preview.html in Chrome or Edge.
3. Try Pipeline, Contacts, Companies, Activities & Tasks, the business switch,
   a deal card, New deal, and Actions > Bigin import review.

This clickable preview uses example records only. It does not need installation
or login. Changes reset when you reload it.

TO UPDATE YOUR VERCEL PREVIEW
Follow docs/CRM_DESIGN_REBUILD.md. Use your existing crm-review branch and the
separate CRM test database. Keep your private environment files and Git folder.
The full ERP source is included. This update changes the CRM presentation and
adds a read only CSV review; it does not require a new database migration.

Do not import or repair live contacts as part of deploying this UI update.
